appName: Extreme Ski Jump VR : Winter Flight
displayName: Extreme Ski Jump VR : Winter Flight
display_name: Extreme Ski Jump VR : Winter Flight
display_long_description:
Take flight and conquer the mountains in Extreme Ski Jump VR: Winter Flight — the ultimate virtual reality ski jumping experience.
Feel the adrenaline rush as you launch from towering ramps, slice through the icy air, and fight for a perfect landing on stunning snow-covered peaks. Every jump tests your timing, balance, and courage as you chase record-breaking distances and picture-perfect style points.
Built for realistic physics and full VR immersion, this game captures the true thrill of ski jumping like never before. Experience breathtaking alpine views, dynamic weather, and responsive motion controls that make every run unique. Fine-tune your technique, master your takeoff and landing, and rise through the global leaderboards to prove you’re the ultimate winter flight champion.
Whether you’re a winter sports enthusiast or a thrill-seeking newcomer, Extreme Ski Jump VR: Winter Flight delivers a heart-pounding mix of realism, fun, and freedom. Strap in, take a deep breath, and get ready to soar beyond limits — the mountains are waiting for your best jump.
